description: Stable public API of the TmDiagramEditor toolbar contract (DiagramEditor redesign, phase 1). The group set, the data-tm-group attribute values and both enums must survive toolbar regrouping (phase 4) unchanged — hosts and the Modeling package key off them instead of positional CSS selectors.
